theorems.name: Rep.isZero_tateCohomology_of_forall_sylow
theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type u} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep.{u} k G) (q : ℤ) (h : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (P : Sylow p G) [Fintype (P : Subgroup G)], CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero ((Rep.res (P : Subgroup G).subtype A).tateCohomology q)), CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (A.tateCohomology q)
theorems.natural_summary: The accepted index-annihilation lemma supplies positive annihilators avoiding each prime via Sylow indices. The accepted arithmetic lemma makes every element zero; ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton gives the conclusion.
